name: 時刻の書式と外部の説明を調整する利用設定
prompt:
Input roles: Image 1: secondary Japanese mock: exact target layout and Japanese content. Image 2: edit target: registered generated v003. Image 3: original source crop: control anatomy and fine dividers. Image 4: approved forest-green style direction.
Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted correction of LH07-0108. The Japanese mock is the primary geometry and exact-copy target; the original crop controls radio and divider anatomy. Preserve official white, forest-green and slate colors, flat surfaces, and compact comfortable density.
At exactly 390 x 284, make the first heading top y=20, selected 12-hour row y=59, unselected 24-hour row y=104, first divider y=140, second heading y=171, selected description row y=208, lower divider y=244, and footer row y=255. Relative to v003, raise only the first heading about 10px; keep radio rows near their target positions; lower the first divider about 8px; lower the second heading about 18px, its selected row about 15px, lower divider about 23px, and footer about 14px. Restore vertical space before and within the second section. Match the Japanese mock margins, line spacing, and type scale. Exact strings: 時刻の書式; 12時間表記（例：午後2:00）; 24時間表記（例：14:00）; ウェブ上の説明を表示; 空のメモと、自分のメモの下に表示; プライバシーの説明・お問い合わせ. Do not add spaces within the labels, wrap the 12-hour or 24-hour rows, change selection state, add icons besides radio controls, or add shadows/chrome/extra content. Return only the panel.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
